caption: The decoder starts from c = [1, 0] and at each step takes the largest logit: step 1 picks a (index 0), then a is fed back and step 2 picks c (index 2). The two highlighted cells are those argmax choices, so the output sequence is [a, c], token indices [0, 2].

spec.title: Greedy decoding, 2 steps
spec.aria: A table with the four tokens a, b, c, end as columns; step 1 logits are 2, 1, 0, minus 1 and the largest at column a is marked, step 2 logits are 0, 1, 2, minus 1 and the largest at column c is marked, giving the output sequence a then c.
